description: This header file declares an interface for message bus interactions in the DHCP Manager component of the system. It includes function prototypes for engaging with the message bus, initializing, finalizing, checking bus status, and freeing resources, all related to the SSP message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages or connects to the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SSP message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes or cleans up the SSP message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.
